title: Assistant says users don't hold any funds

acceptableCauses.mechanism: user-context-service timed out building contexts when a push campaign more than doubled assistant traffic (worker pool saturated).
On timeout it cached an empty context (holdings=0) with a 6 h TTL, so users keep getting "no holdings" after the timeouts stopped.

requiredEvidence.description: empty context cached with long TTL
missing-context rate stays high after timeouts stop

keyCounterevidence: Timeouts stopped around 10:45 IST but missing_context_rate stayed elevated: the timeout alone does not explain the ongoing failures.
portfolio-service latency and errors stayed normal after its 09:58 IST deploy.
notes: Two-cause scenario: full credit needs both causes in the top two hypotheses; half credit if the top hypothesis is one of them.
